title: Credit Balance Office Standard — Credits on the Patient Financial Account
content:
**How a credit arises.** A credit arises on a Patient Financial Account when the payments and adjustments applied to the account exceed the charges — most often when insurance pays after the patient already paid an estimate.

**Clauses no longer in force.** Two clauses of this standard are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current basis:

1. the clause that applied the credit, before any refund, to any other open charge on the account, oldest date of service first, leaving only the remainder refundable;
2. the clause that refunded a remaining credit of at least the refund threshold within the refund processing time after the hold ended, to the method of the payment that created it (a cash payment by check), and left a smaller credit on the account for future charges.

The refund threshold, the credit hold and the refund processing time remain the figures of the financial classes.

**Credit hold.** The credit balance has been held for at least the tier's credit hold period counted from the posting date of the payment that created the credit. The hold is counted in calendar days starting the day after that posting date, and the refund may be issued on the day the hold ends. The posting date is the one on that payment's own ledger line.

| Refund date (hypothetical, 45-day hold, payment posted on day 0) | Hold elapsed? |
|---|---|
| day 44 | no |
| day 45 — the day the hold ends | yes |
| day 60 | yes |

**Once per payment.** A payment's credit is refunded at most once; the ledger shows whether a refund entry already exists against that payment.

**Account status.** The account status is active, billing hold or closed when the refund is issued.

| Account status when the refund would be issued | Refund may be issued |
|---|---|
| active, billing hold, closed | yes |
| registered, precollection, collections | no |

**Accounts in collections.** A credit on an account in collections is first reported to the agency and refunded only after recall.

superseded_clauses: Before any refund the credit is applied to any other open charge on the account, oldest date of service first, and only what remains is refundable.

A remaining credit of at least refund_threshold_usd is refunded, within refund_processing_business_days after the hold ends, to the method of that payment (a cash payment is refunded by check); a smaller credit stays on the account for future charges.
